summary.text: Erin Gámez is a Democratic state representative from Texas House District 38 who took office on March 15, 2022 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Erin Gamez was born in Brownsville, Texas.
She earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Texas at Austin in 2010 and a J.D. from South Texas College of Law Houston in 2014.
Her career experience includes working as an attorney in criminal, civil and family law.
Gamez's committee assignments in the 2023-2024 legislative session were Transportation and Natural Resources.
